title: RAW UNREVIEWED: an observer change shifts apparent position without moving the object
summary: Find a complete dated astronomical or optical primary that explicitly keeps one observed object fixed while two identified observing sites or sight lines produce different apparent positions, and also states a true-motion alternative. Freeze source geometry, object identity and directional displacement before considering already admitted diagrams and their full text. A candidate reading must distinguish observer-dependent appearance from actual object movement across the paired cases. A manuscript observer coordinate or eligible paired target is not asserted; no closed zodiac or eclipse mapping is reopened by this raw proposal.

design.mechanism: a source-owned change of observation site changes apparent position while object identity stays fixed
design.unit: one complete historical paired observation and complete already admitted candidate diagram-text records
design.contrast: observer-dependent apparent displacement versus real object motion
design.prediction: one frozen whole reading assigns stable object identity, two observer positions and the correct apparent displacement; absent an authorial target coordinate means no capacity
